tagline: Strike from the dark, slip back into the pipes, and let the rats hold the line

featuredCards.title: The Sewer Tithe
featuredCards.caption: A card now and a bad choice for them: discard, or hand him another one. The draw engine starts here.

featuredCards.title: A Sharp Refrain
featuredCards.caption: Two cards off an attack — and the special ability walks him out of reach right after it.

featuredCards.title: Pickings from the Wounded
featuredCards.caption: Draws a card for every point that got through. Damage and card advantage stop being separate things.

featuredCards.title: A Killing Note
featuredCards.caption: No text at all — a 5 with a 4 on the back. The hand he has been building finally just hits you.
